notes.title: Update 2.1.8 — Multilingual UI Improvements
notes.content: [p]The 2.1.8 update focuses on improving the quality of the multilingual UI.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where button and label text would clip or overlap in some languages[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted text wrapping, alignment, and sizing[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized UI image scaling and spacing[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced overall readability and accessibility[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]We will continue to improve the experience so players across all regions can enjoy the game comfortably.[/p]

notes.title: Dungeon Tracer – Fan Translation Suggestions
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hello Adventurers,[/p][p]The Dungeon Tracer development team values feedback from our fan community and is officially running a [b]Fan Translation Suggestion Page[/b].
You can easily submit translation suggestions either [b]by clicking the “Translation Suggestion” button in-game[/b] or through the official page below.[/p][p][b]How to Suggest[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Click the link below or use the in-game “Translation Suggestion” button.[/p][/*][*][p]Select the source language.[/p][/*][*][p]Click [b]Load[/b] to display the current translation.[/p][/*][*][p]The [i]Current[/i] field shows the existing translation, and the [i]Your Suggestion[/i] field is where you write your proposed translation.[/p][/*][*][p]Include the reason for your suggestion or any reference materials to assist the review process.[/p][/*][*][p]Once complete, click [b]Submit changes[/b] to send your suggestion.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Fan Translation Suggestion Page[/b]
[/p][p][url="https://dungeontracer.com/l10n_suggest.html"]https://dungeontracer.com/l10n_suggest.html[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Suggestions containing profanity, slander, or copyright-infringing content may be removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Not all suggestions will be applied; final translations will be determined after review by the development team.[/p][/*][/list][p]Your contributions will help make Dungeon Tracer even more polished and enjoyable.[/p]

notes.title: Update 2.1.6 – New Languages & Translation Improvements
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Update 2.1.6 – Windows / Mac[/p][p]Ukrainian, Turkish, Dutch, and Polish have been newly added.[/p][p]The quality of existing multilingual translations has been improved.[/p][p]Dungeon Tracer now officially supports 22 languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Thai, French, German, Russian, Vietnamese, Swedish, Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Latin America), Arabic, Italian, Indonesian, Hindi, Portuguese (Brazil), Ukrainian, Turkish, Dutch, and Polish.[/p][p]If you would like to suggest translation improvements, please visit [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/dungeontracer"]https://discord.gg/dungeontracer[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: New Enemy Appears: The Debt Collector!
notes.content: [p]## New Enemy Appears: Debt Collector (v2.1.5)[/p][p]A special enemy has been added: the Debt Collector.[/p][p]- Each turn, 2 regular coins are converted into Debt Coins.[/p][p]- Debt Coins work like normal ones, but carry risk.[/p][p]- When the Debt Collector is defeated, you will lose gold equal to 2 times the number of Debt Coins you collected.[/p][p]- If you do not have enough gold, your HP will be drained instead, down to 1 HP.[/p][p]Use Debt Coins wisely, or pay the price.[/p][p]Now live in Version 2.1.5.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 2.1.4: Skill Description Bug Fixed
notes.content:
[p][b]\[Update 2.1.4 Patch Notes][/b][/p][p]This update addresses a UI bug related to skill descriptions for a clearer gameplay experience.[/p][p][b]Key Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the previous skill’s description would remain visible after swapping to a new skill[/p][/*][*][p]Now the correct description is displayed for the newly equipped skill[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who reported this issue!
We’ll continue to improve the experience with your feedback in mind.[/p]

notes.title: Update 2.1.3: Rogue's Greed Skill Bug Fix
notes.content: [p]Update 2.1.3 (2025-07-22)[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where defeating a Lich with the Rogue's Greed skill caused relic chests to duplicate and blocks to overlap.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you to all the players who reported this issue.[/p]

notes.title: Update 2.1.2: Auto Select Default & Patch Notes System
notes.content:
[p][b]■ Auto Select Default OFF[/b]
Auto Select is now turned off by default.
If you prefer the previous behavior, you can re-enable it in the Settings menu.[/p][p][b]■ Patch Notes System[/b]
You can now view update history directly from within the game.
New updates will show a popup once upon first login.[/p]

notes.title: Update 2.1.1: UI & Auto Click Improvements
notes.content:
[p][b]\[Update 2.1.1 Patch Notes][/b][/p][p]This update focuses on UI fixes and improvements to auto click behavior for a smoother gameplay experience.[/p][p][b]Key Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed text being cut off on the left side of the guide screen[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted background transparency in some scroll views for better readability[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed flickering tooltips for special enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where turn would not progress when using a skill during auto click[/p][/*][*][p]Added right-click outside the board to cancel auto click[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where damage text didn't follow the mouse during auto click[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing!
We’ll continue to improve the experience with your feedback in mind.[/p]

notes.title: Leaderboard Cleanup and Discord Button Added (2.1.0)
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]In this update, we’ve made some improvements to both leaderboard integrity and community accessibility.[/p][p]First, we identified and removed scores on the leaderboard that were incorrectly registered due to a previous issue. To ensure fairness, we’ve re-synced the leaderboard using the highest scores stored locally on each device and updated them under the correct difficulty.[/p][p]Second, we’ve added a Discord button in the game. You can now join our community directly from within the game to share feedback, report issues, or just hang out.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Now Playable on Steam Deck!
notes.content: [p][b]Playable on Steam Deck[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656874/0b594ac5a888f2ccddded60e98b5c916ad4c9384.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We've received many questions about whether our game works on Steam Deck — and we're happy to confirm that yes, it does![/p][p][b]Steam Deck Support[/b][/p][list][*][p]The game runs smoothly on Steam Deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Supports key input methods including the touchpad, virtual keyboard, and game controller.[/p][/*][*][p]For best experience, set your controller layout to “Gamepad with Gyro” in Steam Deck settings.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Please Note[/b][/p][list][*][p]This title has not yet received Valve's official Steam Deck Verified certification.[/p][/*][*][p]Some manual configuration may be needed, depending on your setup.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing our game — now also on Steam Deck![/p]

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes (v2.0.8)
notes.content: [p]Minor Bug Fixes (v2.0.8)[/p][p]We’ve resolved several minor bugs and made small improvements to enhance the overall gameplay experience.[/p][p]Fix Details  [/p][p]- Fixed minor UI glitches  [/p][p]- Improved internal logic for better stability  [/p][p]- General polish and cleanup[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Leaderboard Score Registration Bug Fix (2.0.7)
notes.content: [p]Leaderboard Bug Fix Notice (2.0.7)[/p][p]We've resolved an issue where high scores were **not properly recorded per difficulty level** on the leaderboard.[/p][p]Fix Details  [/p][p]- Fixed an issue where high scores were not properly recorded per difficulty level  [/p][p]- Now, the highest score for (Normal / Hard / Very Hard) is correctly registered on the leaderboard[/p][p]Thank you for your feedback and support.  [/p][p]We'll continue to improve the game experience![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo - Update 1.0.42 – Control Refinement & Difficulty Adjustment
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to your valuable feedback. We’ve made two key improvements in this update:[/p][p][/p][p]Control Refinement[/p][p]The action to confirm auto-link is now mapped to:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Enter key (Keyboard)[/p][/*][*][p]B button (Gamepad)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]The previous method of double-pressing Tab or RT is no longer supported.[/p][p][/p][p]Difficulty Adjustment[/p][p]We’ve slightly reduced the overall difficulty of the game.[/p][p]This change is intended to make a wider range of strategies and combinations more accessible to all players.[/p][p][/p][p]Please continue testing and let us know how it feels.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing![/p][p]Dungeon Tracer – Puzzle Roguelike RPG[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 1.0.40 – Keyboard & Gamepad Support (Experimental)
notes.content: [p]🎮 New Experimental Feature – Keyboard & Gamepad Support![/p][p]You can now play **Dungeon Tracer** using only your keyboard or gamepad – no mouse required![/p][p]### ⌨️ Keyboard Controls[/p][p]- Arrow Keys: Move between blocks[/p][p]- Space: Select and connect[/p][p]- Enter: Confirm[/p][p]- Tab: Auto-link[/p][p]### 🎮 Gamepad Controls[/p][p]- Left Stick: Move[/p][p]- A: Select and connect[/p][p]- B: Confirm[/p][p]- RT: Auto-link[/p][p]🧪 **This feature is experimental and still in testing.**[/p][p]The final version may change depending on your feedback.[/p][p]Please try it out and let us know how it feels![/p][p]Thank you for supporting Dungeon Tracer 💙[/p][p]📢 We'd love to hear your feedback in our Discord [/p][p] 👉 [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/VtNbMbzU"]https://discord.gg/VtNbMbzU[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo - Update 1.0.31 – Smart Path Auto-Select Added!
notes.content: [p] 🆕 Version 1.0.31 Update Notes[/p][p]A new [b]experimental feature[/b] has been added to improve accessibility and comfort![/p][p]🖱 Right-Click Auto Select[/p][p]- Right-click a block to automatically select the longest possible path.[/p][p]- Right-click again on the same block to cancel the selection.[/p][p]- Right-click a different block to reset and start from that one.[/p][p]- Left-click the last block to confirm the path.[/p][p]- Left-click any block in the middle to adjust the path up to that point.[/p][p]🔁 If all blocks are the same type, a special zigzag path will be auto-selected (max 18 blocks supported).[/p][p]💡 This feature is only available in the demo version and is experimental![/p][p]🙌 We hope this feature helps reduce wrist strain and makes long sessions more comfortable![/p][p][/p][p]🔧 Additionally, major fixes have been made to the Leaderboard system. It should now work properly, but we need your help to test it thoroughly.[/p][p]👉 Try it out, and let us know your thoughts on the Community Hub![/p][p][/p]
